## Description

Pairs fractional integration memory parameters ($d$) with time-varying copulas to model and trade non-linear, persistent cointegrated spread distributions across asset pairs.

## Where it may fit

Persistent cointegrated asset pairs with non-linear tail dependency structures during market stress.

## Vehicles

Statistical Arbitrage Funds, Quantitative Equity Market-Neutral Desks.

## Required data

Historical price series of paired assets, fractional differencing parameters, copula fitting windows.

## Caveats

Maximum likelihood copula fitting combined with fractional estimation requires robust historical sample lengths.
